title: Abelian presheaves form an abelian category with exact evaluation functors
statement: Let $\mathcal C$ be a category and $\textit{PAb}(\mathcal C)$ the category of presheaves of abelian groups on $\mathcal C$, i.e. functors $\mathcal C^{op}\to\textit{Ab}$, with natural transformations as morphisms and the sectionwise addition of morphisms ($(\varphi+\psi)_W=\varphi_W+\psi_W$). Then $\textit{PAb}(\mathcal C)$ is an abelian category [def-sp-abelian], and for every object $W$ of $\mathcal C$ the evaluation functor $\mathrm{ev}_W:\textit{PAb}(\mathcal C)\to\textit{Ab}$, $\mathcal F\mapsto\mathcal F(W)$, $\varphi\mapsto\varphi_W$, is additive and exact: it commutes with finite limits and finite colimits (kernels, cokernels, finite products are computed sectionwise). In particular, if $\mathcal F'\xrightarrow{a}\mathcal F\xrightarrow{b}\mathcal F''$ is a sequence in $\textit{PAb}(\mathcal C)$ with $b\circ a=0$ that is exact at $\mathcal F$, then $\mathcal F'(W)\xrightarrow{a_W}\mathcal F(W)\xrightarrow{b_W}\mathcal F''(W)$ is an exact sequence of abelian groups for every object $W$.
